t: Shello leekol veshello lishtot velo laasot shum melaka qodem sheyyabdil
s: Shello leekol veshello lishtot velo laasot shum melaka qodem sheyyabdil ubo k"a seipim: aseru chakamim leekol shum dabar, o lishtot shum mashqeh, chutz mimmayim, bemotzae shabbat, ad sheyyabdil al hakkos, ap al pi shehibdil kebar bitpilla. Vaapillu litom meat asur, mittaam shennitbaer besimman ra"a:

Vaapillu haya yosheb veshoteh mibbeod yom — tzarik lehapsiq keshemmaggia ben hashshemashot, shehu sepeq layla. Abal im haya yosheb veokel mibbeod yom — eno tzarik lehapsiq apillu mishshetiyya, apillu keshemmaggia vadday layla, verashshay lehamshik bisuddato kamma sheyyirtzeh tok hallayla, kevan shehitchil behetter. Abal im shakach vehitchil hasseudda beissur, dehaynu mibben hashshemashot veelak — tzarik lehapsiq miyyad shennizkar. Veyesh mattirin apillu lehatchil beben hashshemashot, ben leekol ben lishtot, veen issur ella bevadday layla, sheaz hu zeman harauy lehabdala. Veken nitpashshet hamminhag bisuddot gedolot shemmatchilin beben hashshemashot, veen limchot beyadam, kevan sheyyesh lahem al mah sheyyismeku. Abal haiqqar kasbara harishona. Uledibre hakkol, keshemmaggia vadday layla — tzarik apillu lehapsiq im haya qabua lishtiyya bilbad mibbeod yom. Vaapillu meakila im shakach vehitchil bevadday layla — tzarik lehapsiq miyyad shennizkar. Veim nizkar leachar shebberak "hammotzi" qodem shettaam perusat "hammotzi" — yitamenna miyyad, veachar kak yabdil, sheim yabdil mittechilla — tehe birkat "hammotzi" lebattala, sheachar kak yitztarek lachazor ulebarek "hammotzi", kevan shehipsiq kol kak ben beraka litima:

Hayu yoshebim veokelim mibbeod yom veachar gemar hasseudda qabeu lishtiyya — en tzarik lehapsiq kesheyyaggia hallayla, shehakkol nechshab lisudda achat kol zeman shello bereku birkat hammazon. Vaapillu ameru zeh lazeh "bou venabdil" vechazeru venimleku lishtot o leekol — hare ellu muttarim lishtot veleekol, veenam tzerikin lehapsiq mechamat sheggameru bedatam veameru lehabdil, vegam enam tzerikin lachazor ulebarek al mah shennimleku leekol velishtot qodem sheyyabdilu, lepi shello hissichu datam legamre meakila ushetiyya ad sheyyabdilu al yede amira zo sheameru lehabdil miyyad, kevan sheyyekolim adayin lachazor bahem veleekol velishtot miyyad qodem sheyyabdilu:

Hammapsiq lehabdil al hakkos beemtza shetiyyato, ap al pi shehaya qabua lishtiyya bilbad shehu chayyab lehapsiq ulehabdil kesheyyaggia hallayla, veasur lo meatta lishtot od ad sheyyabdil — ap al pi ken en tzarik lebarek "bore peri haggapen" al kos shel habdala, shenniptar bebirkat "bore peri haggapen" shebberak al shetiyya harishona, ap al pi shebbenetayim haya sheat issur, dehaynu mishshehiggia hallayla ad shehibdil. Veen tzarik lomar im mapsiq beemtza akilato umabdil al hayyayin, sheen tzarik lebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen" im kebar berak "bore peri haggapen" al yayin shebbetok hasseudda o shellipne hasseudda. Veim hu mabdil al hashshekar — en tzarik lebarek alayv "shehakkol" betok hasseudda, ap al pi shello berak adayin "shehakkol" lo betok hasseudda velo lipne hasseudda, shebbirkat "hammotzi" poteret et hashshekar shel habdala, kemo sheppoteret shear shekar sheshshotin betok hasseudda. Ulepi sheyyesh choleqim al kol zeh, laken tob lizzaher lekattechilla shello lehabdil qodem birkat hammazon lo al hashshekar, velo al hayyayin im kebar berak "bore peri haggapen" al yayin. Veim hu rotzeh lehabdil, o shello haya qabua ella lishtiyya bilbad, shehu chayyab lehapsiq ulehabdil — lo yebarek al kos shel habdala, kedea a' shehi iqqar:

Im hitpallel tok hasseudda — chal alayv chobat habdala, veasur lo lachazor lisuddato ad sheyyabdil mittechilla al hakkos. Vaapillu hiqdim lehitpallel arbit mibbeod yom — chal alayv chobat habdala miyyad, veasur lo litom kelum, chutz mimmayim, ad sheyyabdil:

Keshehaya yosheb veokel mibbeod yom sheeno tzarik lehapsiq misseuddato ulehabdil qodem birkat hammazon — yesh lo lishtot gam ken mikkos shel birkat hammazon ap al pi shello hibdil adayin, lepi shekkos shel birkat hammazon hu gam ken mikkelal hasseudda lemi shennizhar leolam lebarek birkat hammazon al hakkos. Abal mi shemmebarek lipamim belo kos lepi shessomek al haomerim shebbirkat hammazon enah teuna kos — asur lo lishtot atta mikkos birkat hammazon qodem habdala:

Ben mi shemmuttar lo lishtot mimmennu uben mi sheasur lo lishtot mimmennu qodem habdala — eno yakol gam lehabdil alayv miyyad qodem sheyyishteh mimmennu, ella yabdil al kos yayin acher im yesh lo, lepi shebbirkat hammazon hi qedushsha bipne atzmah vehabdala hi qedushsha bipne atzmah, veen omerim b' qedushshot al kos yayin echad kesheepshar leomran al b' kosot, lepi sheen osin mitzvot chabilot chabilot. Abal im en lo od yayin lekos habdala — tzarik lehabdil alayv miyyad qodem sheyyishteh mimmennu achar birkat hammazon, velo yeacher hahabdala im hashshetiyya leachar zeman, lepi shetztzarik lishtot mikkos birkat hammazon miyyad achar birkat hammazon lehaomerim shebbirkat hammazon teuna kos. (Veap lehaomerim sheenah teuna kos, mikkol maqom kevan shehu mebarek akshav birkat hammazon al hakkos, lepi shelledibre hakkol yesh al kol panim mitzva min hammubchar lebarek al hakkos, im ken yesh lo gam ken lishtoto miyyad achar birkat hammazon lemitzva min hammubchar, ap al pi sheen chiyyub baddabar, velaken yesh lo lehabdil miyyad achar birkat hammazon al kos zeh kede lishtoto miyyad. Veim yesh lo od yayin lekos habdala — yesh lo lehabdil miyyad al kos shel yayin hashsheni, velo yebarek "bore peri haggapen" al kos harishon shel birkat hammazon, ella al kos sheni shel habdala, umiyyad achar shetiyyat kos habdala — yishteh gam ken kos birkat hammazon lemitzva min hammubchar):

Iqqar mitzvat habdala ballayla. Shakach o hezid velo hibdil belel motzae shabbat — yabdil lemachar bayyom. Veasur lo az litom meuma, chutz mimmayim, ad sheyyabdil, kemo sheasur ballayla. Shakach o hezid veakal qodem habdala — tzarik lehapsiq miyyad ulehabdil, kemo im hitchil leekol ballayla. Veim lo hibdil lemachar beyom a' — yabdil beyom sheni qodem sheyyitom, kemo shennitbaer beyom a', veken ad sop yom g'. Abal mishsham veelak eno yakol lehabdil od, lepi sheg' yamim harishonim shel hashshabua niqraim yamim sheachar hashshabbat, vahare hen biklal motzae shabbat, abal g' yamim haacharonim niqraim yamim shellipne hashshabbat habbaa, veen lahem inyan leshabbat sheobra:

Keshemmabdil beyom rishon o mishsham veelak — lo yebarek ella birkat "bore peri haggapen" ubirkat hahabdala, abal lo yebarek al haur, sheen mebarekin al haur ella belel motzae shabbat, shehu techillat beriyyato al yede adam harishon, kemo shennitbaer besimman rch"tz. Veken al habbesamim lo hitzriku lebarek ella belel motzae shabbat shehu samuk litziat hashshabbat, abal achar kak en lahem inyan lekos hahabdala, ulepikak asur lehapsiq bebirkatam ben birkat hayyayin lishtiyyato:

Mi shemmitanneh g' yamim veg' lelot millel motzae shabbat veelak — yishma habdala meacherim. Veim en acherim etzlo — yakol lehabdil beshabbat mippelag hammincha ulemala belo besamim vener velishtot mehakkos, veachar kak meqabbel hattaanit alayv. Uballayla yebarek al hanner ubesamim belo kos. Veyakol lehitpallel arbit gam ken mibbeod yom qodem sheyyabdil, ubilbad sheyyiqra qeriat shema bizmanna, kemo shennitbaer besimman rtz"g. Abal mi shemmitanneh b' yamim bilbad — lo yabdil beshabbat mibbeod yom ella bemotzae yom b':

Umi shemmitanneh b' yamim ub' lelot lipne rosh hashshana vechal rosh hashshana beyom g' — lo yamtin millehabdil ad motzae yom b' shehu lel rosh hashshana, lepi sheyyitztarek lomar yaqha"z al kos echad o al pat echad kemo shetztzarik beyom tob shechal bemotzae shabbat, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman ta"g, veyesh bezeh issur mishshum sheen omerim b' qedushshot al kos echad, sheqqiddush yom tob hi qedushsha bipne atzmah veen lah inyan lehabdalat motzae shabbat shel chol, mah sheen ken beyom tob shechal bemotzae shabbat shemmazkirin qedushshat yom tob gam bahabdala, shemmabdilin ben qodesh leqodesh, hare haqqiddush vehahabdala keinyan echad, abal kan shetztzarik lehabdil habdalat motzae shabbat shehi ben qodesh lechol — en lah inyan kelal leqiddush shel yom tob, lepikak eno yakol lomar shettehen al kos echad o al pat echad, mittaam shennitbaer lemala:

Veim era shehimtin millehabdil ad lel rosh hashshana — yishma qiddush meacherim. Velo yitom perusat "hammotzi" ad sheyyabdil al hakkos veyishteh, shehare asur litom kelum qodem habdala, veachar kak yebarek "hammotzi" veyokal miyyad kede sheyyehe haqqiddush bimqom seudda. Veap im haacherim qiddeshu al pat vehotziu oto yede chobato ap mibbirkat "hammotzi" — ap al pi ken tzarik hu gam ken lebarek "hammotzi" leatzmo, hoil vehipsiq behabdala al hakkos ben shemiato birkat "hammotzi" laakilato, ap al pi sheyyede qiddush yatza bemah shettaamu hem mehappat ap shehu adayin lo taam, mikkol maqom leinyan hepseq ben birkat "hammotzi" laakila — en teimatam moelet lo, kemo shennitbaer besimman qs"z:

Hammabdil al hayyayin verotzeh lisod miyyad, im birkat hayyayin shel habdala poteret hayyayin shebbetok hasseudda — nitbaer besimman qa"d, vesham nitbaer ematay tzarik lebarek beraka acharona al kos habdala shellipne hasseudda, ben shehu yayin ben shehu shear mashqim, ayyen sham:

Im rotzeh lisod tekep lehabdala — tzarik lizzaher shello yabiu lechem lashshulchan qodem habdala. Veim hebiu — tzarik lekassoto bemappa ad achar hahabdala, shello yireh happat boshto, shehare min haddin haya tzarik lehaqdim birkat hallechem lebirkat hayyayin kesherotzeh leekol miyyad, lepi shehu muqdam leyayin beshebach eretz yisrael bappasuq "eretz chitta useora vego'", ella sheakshav eno yakol lehaqdimo, vahare zeh bizzayon lo, laken yesh lekassoto. Abal im eno rotzeh lisod miyyad — eno tzarik lekassoto:

Ap al pi sheyyatza hashshabbat vehosip mechol al haqqodesh — asur leadam sheyyaaseh chapatzayv qodem sheyyelavveh et hammelek, dehaynu sheyyabdil o al hakkos o bitpilla, vaapillu chapatzim haasurim beshabbat atzmah middibre soperim. (Abal issuray dibre soperim hatteluyim bedibbur muttarim, mittaam shennitbaer besop simman rs"g, chutz mibbaqqashat tzerakayv sheaseru qodem sheyyabdil bitpilla, kemo shennitbaer besimman rtz"d). Veken yesh mattirin kol issure dibre soperim sheen bahem serak melaka veenan asurim mishshum shebut ella mishshum ubedin dechol. Veken nohagim bemotzae yom hakkippurim, kemo sheyyitbaer basimman tarak"[g]:

Veim rotzeh laasot apillu melaka gemura qodem sheyyabdil bitpilla o al hakkos — omer "baruk hammabdil ben qodesh lechol" belo shem umalkut lehekker beolma, lelavvot hammelek, veoseh melaka. Abal asur litom kelum ap im hibdil bitpilla vegam amar "hammabdil", ad sheyyabdil al hakkos:
Im chal yom tob bemotzae shabbat verotzeh laasot melaka hammutteret beyom tob qodem sheyyabdil bitpilla — omer "baruk hammabdil ben qodesh leqodesh" belo shem umalkut:

Otan hannashim sheenan mitpalelot arbit veenan mabdilot bitpilla bemotzae shabbat — yesh lelammedan lomar "baruk hammabdil ben qodesh lechol" qodem asiyyat melaka lipne habdala sheal hakkos. Veim enan yodeot lomar "hammabdil" — tzerikot lishmoa meacherim. Veim osot qodem shemiatan — en limchot beyadan, ki yesh omerim shello aseru ella melakot gemurot, kegon koteb veoreg vachatibat etzim vekayyotze bahem, abal hadlaqat hanner beolma vehotzaa mereshut lirshut vetiltul d' ammot birshut harabbim sheen bahem torach kelal — lo aseru kelal. Veap sheen dibrehem iqqar (velo hutteru melakot sheen bahem torach ella leyesh omerim sheap shehibdil bitpilla vegam amar "hammabdil" belo beraka asur bimlaka ad sheyyabdil al hakkos, shelledibrehem, al kol panim, bimlakot sheen bahem torach — muttar miyyad shehibdil bitpilla, shehare madliqim ner lehabdala, abal qodem shehibdil bitpilla — en hetter beshum melaka, apillu debarim haasurim middibre soperim, al kol panim, im lo amar "hammabdil"), mikkol maqom hannashim shennahagu kak — en tzarik limchot beyadan. Abal im hen osot melakot gemurot — tzarik limchot beyadan. Velaken yesh lidrosh barabbim sheyyelammedu benotehem lomar "hammabdil" bemotzae shabbat miyyad, mippene sheharbeh mehen mabirot etzim veesh umechammemot mayim, shehen melakot gemurot:

Vekol zeh leinyan limchot benashim sheenan yodeot lomar "hammabdil", abal haanashim asurim apillu betiltul hanner vekayyotze bazeh qodem sheyyabdilu bitpilla o sheyyomru "hammabdil". Vekol baal nepesh yachmir leatzmo shello lehadliq velo laasot shum melaka qodem seder qedushsha shel hatztzibbur, ap al pi shekkebar hibdil bitpilla vegam amar "hammabdil". Vekol haoseh melaka qodem seder qedushsha — eno roeh simman beraka leolam meotah melaka. Abal tiltul hanner vekayyotze bazeh — muttar miyyad achar shehibdil bitpilla o amar "hammabdil". Veshammash hakkeneset rashshay lehadliq nerot bebet hakkeneset miyyad achar shehibdil bitpilla (o sheamar "hammabdil"), ap al pi shello ameru hatztzibbur adayin seder qedushsha (kevan shehi letzorek mitzva). (Umikkol maqom, tzarik lizzaher lehadliq achar sheameru hatztzibbur "bareku"):

Qetzat nohagim lidlot mayim bekol motzae shabbat mehabbeerot o mehammayanot, lepi sheameru chakamim shebbeerah shel miryam shehi beyammah shel teberya hi mechazzeret bekol motzae shabbat al kol habbeerot vehammayanot, vekol mi sheppogea bah veshoteh mimmemeha mitrappe miyyad mikkol tachaluayv, lekak nohagin lidlot bekol motzae shabbat, ki ulay yizdammenu lahem mibbeerah shel miryam:
Mi shemmosip mechol al haqqodesh harbeh im muttar lomar lemi shehibdil sheyyebashshel lo vihe muttar lo leekol miyyad mittabshil zeh — nitbaer besimman rs"g:
